samples.summary: DOM-free `node.ts` entry exports `NoteStore` but not the new `NoteAuthorSpan`, so the Node surface publishes an interface with an unnameable member
samples.evidence: packages/notes/src/node.ts:4-10 re-exports `NoteStore, NoteTextChange, NoteRemoteChange, NotePeerSelection, NoteSelection` from './store/store.js'. `NoteStore` now requires `getAuthorSpans(): NoteAuthorSpan[]` (packages/notes/src/store/store.ts:113-122), but `NoteAuthorSpan` was only added to `src/index.ts` (the DOM entry), not to `node.ts`. `package.json` exports `./node` and maps the `node` condition of `.` to `dist/node.js`, so any Node-side consumer implementing `NoteStore` (or typing the return of `getAuthorSpans`) cannot import the type from the surface it is given.

samples.summary: Share-link note mount is the second `NotesView` entry point and was not updated: no `showAuthors` prop and no toolbar, so the feature is silently unavailable and inconsistent there
samples.evidence: packages/frontend/src/app/shared/shared-document.tsx:345 — `<NotesView readOnly={readOnly} viewMode={readOnly ? "view" : "both"} />`. `SharedNotesLayout` renders no `NotesToolbar` (contrast notes-detail.tsx:198), so a share-link visitor can never enable the gutter and, for an editor-role link, the store is constructed with `recordAuthorship: false` — their lines are permanently unattributed while the owner's app shows attributed lines for the same note. It also never reads the persisted `wafflebase:notes:showAuthors` preference the owner set. Fix belongs here (thread the preference through, or document the asymmetry).

samples.summary: The blame tracker's per-edit empty repaint transaction re-enters every other view plugin, including the one that publishes local selection into Yorkie presence
samples.evidence: packages/notes/src/view/remote-selection.ts:149-161 — `NoteRemoteSelectionsPluginValue.update()` runs on EVERY ViewUpdate (it does not check `docChanged`/`selectionSet`) and unconditionally calls `store.setLocalSelection(...)`, which in `YorkieNoteStore.setLocalSelection` (packages/frontend/src/app/notes/yorkie-note-store.ts:439-461) opens a `doc.update()`. The new tracker dispatches an extra empty transaction per changed edit (`scheduleRepaint`, blame-gutter.ts), so with the gutter on every keystroke now drives an additional full decoration rebuild plus a Yorkie update round. Pre-existing plugin, newly exercised by this change.

samples.summary: Label computation is O(lines × runs) against a CRDT that accumulates one run per edit, so an old, heavily-edited note pays a quadratic walk on every keystroke
samples.evidence: `computeBlameLabels` calls `authorOfRange` per line, and `authorOfRange` scans the whole span list from the start (`for (const span of spans)` with only a `span.from >= to` break) — so cost is lines × spans. `YorkieNoteStore.getAuthorSpans()` (packages/frontend/src/app/notes/yorkie-note-store.ts:200) emits one span per `content.values()` run, and Yorkie splits a run per edit, so an existing long-lived note can carry thousands of runs before this feature ever ships. Both are re-run on every `docChanged` update. The out-of-diff pressure is the pre-existing note data, not the new code path.

samples.summary: Package README's "Public API" list still describes the pre-change export surface
samples.evidence: packages/notes/README.md:29-38 lists the exports of `src/index.ts` and omits `NoteAuthorSpan`, `sanitizeDisplayName`, `MAX_DISPLAY_NAME_LENGTH`, `ANONYMOUS_AUTHOR`, `computeBlameLabels`, `noteBlameGutter`, `noteBlameTracker` — all added to `packages/notes/src/index.ts` by this change.

samples.summary: New barrel exports have no importer outside their own module/tests, which the enforced knip lane flags as unused exports
samples.evidence: `packages/notes/src/index.ts` newly exports `ANONYMOUS_AUTHOR`, `computeBlameLabels`, `noteBlameGutter`, `noteBlameTracker` and `MAX_DISPLAY_NAME_LENGTH`, but `editor.ts:36` imports the gutter directly from './blame-gutter.js' and both new test files import from the module paths ('./blame-gutter.js', './display-name.js'). No consumer reaches them through the barrel.
